input.subject: A Little Winter Magic is on its Way! Riverside on Ice
input.snippet: Riverside on Ice returns November 20. Tickets are on sale now.
input.body_text:
Riverside on Ice returns November 20. Tickets are on sale now.

Opening November 20

Let the Winter Magic Begin! Riverside on Ice returns for another season of skating, sliding, and making memories in the heart of downtown in Commons Park and runs through January 18, 2027.

events.title: Riverside on Ice opens
events.description: Skating rink opening day; the season runs through January 18, 2027. Tickets on sale.

notes: Hand-written expected. Production extracted one all-day event from 2026-11-20 to 2027-01-18; with the user's 8-9am all-day policy it reached Google Calendar as one continuous 8:00 Nov 20 -> 9:00 Jan 18 block. The user attends a rink on a day, not for the season: the event is the opening day, and the run-through date belongs in the description. 'Tickets are on sale now' is an announcement, not the user's purchase, so booking_confirmed is false.
